requirements.text: Students should have the ability to customize their timetables through features like colour-coding modules, toggling cancelled classes, and adding personal study blocks with a user-friendly interface and drag-and-drop functionality.

Develop a notification system that allows students to choose their preferred method of notification (email, SMS, in-app), with immediate alerts for new grades and reminders for assignment deadlines a few days in advance.

Create a feedback form focusing on content quality, delivery methods, and resources, including an open-ended section, while ensuring anonymity and timing feedback release to coordinators after grades are submitted.
Ensure that all enhancements integrate seamlessly with the current portal infrastructure without requiring new accounts or altering the existing database schema.
Adhere to GDPR and the university’s data retention policies, particularly in handling student feedback to maintain anonymity and ensure feedback is only released after grades are submitted.
